Subject: SIG questionnaire follow-up and evidence requests

Aditya —

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. As discussed attached is the completed SIG questionnaire and a short list of supporting artifacts we need to close our review for the pilot (we're targeting security sign-off by 6/24). Can you confirm whether you can provide the following items by EOD 6/17?

1) Access control policy (latest PDF) and an ACL extract showing RBAC groups for production projects.
2) Incident response runbook (PDF or doc) and a short screenshot of the on-call rotation in PagerDuty.
3) Screenshots of IAM console showing SSO configuration and MFA enforcement for admin roles.
4) Architecture diagram (network & VPC boundaries) — editable or PDF is fine.
5) Sample audit/log export (last 90 days) — obfuscated where necessary.

Attachment: FinOptima_SIG_2027.pdf (our completed questionnaire)

Also: please send the Drive folder share link and an evidence index (filename -> evidence id) so our compliance team can track items. If anything needs redaction before sharing, flag it and we can confirm acceptable redaction level.

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
Head of Security, FinOptima
Tom.Reynolds@finoptima.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0123
